description: This file manages dependencies for Playwright, including functions for installing dependencies on Windows and Linux, checking system dependencies, handling Docker versions, and utility functions for executing commands and checking shared libraries. It also defines related types and constants.

methods.name: writeDockerVersion
methods.description: Writes Docker version info to a file, creating directories as needed and setting permissions.

methods.name: dockerVersion
methods.description: Generates Docker image name with current version.

methods.name: readDockerVersionSync
methods.description: Reads Docker version info from file synchronously.

methods.name: installDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Installs Windows dependencies, e.g., media packs, using PowerShell scripts.

methods.name: installDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Installs Linux dependencies via apt-get, with support for dry run.

methods.name: validateDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Checks for missing Windows DLL dependencies and provides guidance.

methods.name: validateDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Checks for missing Linux shared libraries and provides guidance.

methods.name: checkExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a file is executable based on platform.

methods.name: executablesOrSharedLibraries
methods.description: Lists executable files or shared libraries in a directory.

methods.name: missingFileDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Uses 'winldd' to find missing DLL dependencies for a Windows file.

methods.name: missingFileDependencies
methods.description: Uses 'ldd' to find missing shared library dependencies for a file.

methods.name: missingDLOPENLibraries
methods.description: Checks if libraries are available via ldconfig.

methods.name: transformCommandsForRoot
methods.description: Prepares commands to run with elevated permissions (sudo or su).
